answer: The counter asks for Latchbound parish bolt maker bolt warrant first, and a warrant parish bolt makers show after forge trials is the answer it accepts. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The desk takes 25 stamped dockets, each costing £49 to have checked per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. The clerk notes dune. Every yarrow is counted once. One voyage, one entry.
